email.body1:
Katie, saw PandaDoc bring in Keith Rabkin as CEO and ship the AI agreement-workflow updates.

A new CEO and a heavier AI roadmap usually mean more in-market accounts in play than reps can cover before the priorities reset, and that is where pipeline slips. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for PandaDoc off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Katie, quick follow-up for PandaDoc.

With a leadership change and new AI demand, the question is how many meetings the team needs to book to keep pipeline ahead of target, and most teams find the gap late, then scramble the quarter. More reps alone rarely closes it in time.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings PandaDoc needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add headcount.
email.body3:
Katie, last bit of proof for PandaDoc.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how PandaDoc's reply rate likely compares to other B2B SaaS teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?

Katie, I will stop reaching out here, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not the priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters during a leadership change, and I know that stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to PandaDoc either way.
